title: DevGo
tagline: We will create a location based social engagement app for all web3 users globally
description:
Web3 users are global + travel is fulfilling = opportunity for geo-social web3 layer

Our product vision include these features: 
Allow users to travel to key attractions / landmarks to collect the location’s NFT
Social mechanics such as leaderboard / competition
Allow brands to have geo based NFT drops
Allow web3 companies to airdrop to wallets based on locations
Ability to have local businesses/advertisers to create their own landmarks 

The POC is hitting on the main features of building a mobile app, having geolocation, collecting landmark NFTs

Future plans: 
TokenGo will drive the growth of userbase 
Infra layer for all brands to use to engage users
Potential of using ZK to blind actual locations of wallets/users
how_its_made:
This project was built with a cross-platform tool Flutter for the frontend, 

Also used Node.js with Express.js framework, MySQL on AWS EC2 for the backend.

Solidity for scroll. We used Atlas IDE to create and deploy a smart contract for the Scroll chain. Verified on Scroll Etherscan
